### Build the 5-matrix PBplus data object after running PBplus_gating_flow_B_cells_RG_2025 thru to line 771, or the end of the ```{r summarize counts for new root path, save} chunk

```{r build full PB plus object with all 5 matrices}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(stringr)})

####check object names

# nm <- load("/Users/rgomez/Khor_covidvax_response_IMPACD/data_RG_2025_05/counts_NEW_PBplus.Rdata")
# print(nm)   # <- the actual object names that were loaded
# ls()        # sanity check

# ---- Inputs ----
file <- "/Users/rgomez/Khor_covidvax_response_IMPACD/data_RG_2025_05/counts_NEW_PBplus.Rdata"
nm <- load(file)  # returns vector of object names created

# If the expected symbol isn't there, pick the right one and alias it
if (!exists("counts_NEW_PBplus", inherits = TRUE)) {
  # heuristic: look for a data.frame/tibble with Population & name columns
  pick <- NULL
  for (n in nm) {
    obj <- get(n, inherits = TRUE)
    if (is.data.frame(obj) && all(c("Population","name") %in% names(obj))) { pick <- n; break }
  }
  if (is.null(pick) && length(nm) == 1) pick <- nm[1]
  stopifnot(!is.null(pick))
  counts_NEW_PBplus <- get(pick, inherits = TRUE)
}
# double-check expected structure
stopifnot(is.data.frame(counts_NEW_PBplus))

#load("/Users/rgomez/Khor_covidvax_response_IMPACD/data_RG_2025_05/counts_NEW_PBplus.Rdata") # -> counts_NEW_PBplus (long)
stopifnot(exists("design"))


# ROOTS
root_all <- "/Live_Stringent/LYM/Barcode/CD19+ dump-/B cells/PB+"
root_ag  <- "/Live_Stringent/LYM/Barcode/CD19+ dump-/B cells/RBD+/PB+"

strip_prefix <- function(x, prefix){
  out <- x
  i1 <- startsWith(x, paste0(prefix, "/")); out[i1] <- substring(x[i1], nchar(prefix) + 2L)
  i2 <- startsWith(x, prefix) & !i1;        out[i2] <- substring(x[i2], nchar(prefix) + 1L)
  out
}

# ---- Long table with ALId + compartment + relative subset ----
# Map each FCS to ALId and metadata (robust to column name variations)
design_map <- design %>%
  mutate(
    sample_file = dplyr::coalesce(
      get0("sampleNameOriginal", ifnotfound = NULL),
      get0("sampleName",         ifnotfound = NULL),
      basename(get0("fcsFiles",  ifnotfound = ""))  # fallback
    ),
    sample_key  = sub("\\.fcs$","", basename(sample_file))
  ) %>%
  select(
    ALId, sample_key,
    patientType = any_of("patientType"),
    khorLabId   = any_of("khorLabId"),
    ageAtDraw   = any_of("ageAtDraw"),
    sex         = any_of("sex"),
    group       = any_of("group"),
    batch       = any_of("batch"),
    fcs_file        = any_of("fcsFiles"),
    transformed_fcs = any_of("transformedFcs"),
    drawDate        = any_of("drawDate"),
    race            = any_of("race"),
    hispanic        = any_of("hispanic")
  ) %>%
  distinct()

# Attach ALId/metadata to counts_NEW_PBplus
df <- counts_NEW_PBplus %>%
  mutate(
    sample_key  = sub("\\.fcs$","", basename(as.character(name))),
    compartment = if_else(grepl("/RBD\\+/", Population), "antigen_specific", "global")
  ) %>%
  left_join(design_map, by = "sample_key") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("IC", sample_key, fixed = TRUE))

# Sanity: drop rows missing ALId (cannot pivot by AL)
missing_al <- df %>% dplyr::filter(is.na(ALId)) %>% distinct(sample_key)
if (nrow(missing_al)) message("Warning: dropping ", nrow(missing_al), " rows with missing ALId.")

df <- df %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(ALId))

# Relative subset under the two SM roots
rel <- character(nrow(df))
i_all <- startsWith(df$Population, root_all)
i_ag  <- startsWith(df$Population, root_ag)
rel[i_all] <- strip_prefix(df$Population[i_all], root_all)
rel[i_ag ] <- strip_prefix(df$Population[i_ag ], root_ag )
df$rel_subset <- rel

# Final subset label: compartment + "/" + relative (root becomes just "global"/"antigen_specific")
df$subset_label <- if_else(df$rel_subset == "" | is.na(df$rel_subset),
                           df$compartment,
                           paste0(df$compartment, "/", df$rel_subset))

# ---- Matrices: rows=subset_label, cols=ALId ----
collapse_wide <- function(dat, value_col){
  dat %>%
    group_by(subset_label, ALId) %>%
    summarize(val = dplyr::first(.data[[value_col]]), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(ALId = as.character(ALId)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = ALId, values_from = val) %>%
    arrange(subset_label)
}

pctParent    <- collapse_wide(df, "PercentParent")
parentCounts <- collapse_wide(df, "ParentCount")
popCounts    <- collapse_wide(df, "Count")

## ---- Nodes: terminal_node + clean modifiers + root columns ----
# pick the subset column you actually have
subset_vec <- if ("subset_label" %in% names(pctParent)) pctParent$subset_label else pctParent$subset

make_nodes <- function(subset_vec, root_all, root_ag) {
  comp <- ifelse(grepl("^antigen_specific($|/)", subset_vec), "antigen_specific", "global")
  rel  <- ifelse(comp == "global",
                 sub("^global/?", "", subset_vec),
                 sub("^antigen_specific/?", "", subset_vec))
  
  parts <- strsplit(rel, "/", fixed = TRUE)
  ncomp <- vapply(parts, length, integer(1))
  
  terminal_node <- vapply(seq_along(parts), function(i) {
    if (ncomp[i] == 0) comp[i] else tail(parts[[i]], 1)
  }, character(1))
  
  modifier_1 <- vapply(seq_along(parts), function(i) {
    if (ncomp[i] >= 2) parts[[i]][1] else NA_character_
  }, character(1))
  
  modifier_2 <- vapply(seq_along(parts), function(i) {
    if (ncomp[i] >= 3) parts[[i]][2] else NA_character_
  }, character(1))
  
  depth <- ncomp  # root (no tokens) = 0; single token = 1; etc.
  
  rootPath <- ifelse(comp == "global", root_all, root_ag)
  pathInCompartment <- ifelse(ncomp == 0, NA_character_, rel)
  path <- ifelse(ncomp == 0, rootPath, paste(rootPath, rel, sep = "/"))
  
   # compute root as "global/<relative_root>" or "antigen_specific/<relative_root>"
  base_prefix <- "/Live_Stringent/LYM/Barcode/CD19+ dump-/B cells"
  root <- ifelse(
    comp == "global",
    paste0("global/", strip_prefix(root_all, base_prefix)),            # -> "global/PB+"
    paste0("antigen_specific/", strip_prefix(root_ag,  base_prefix))   # -> "antigen_specific/RBD+/PB+"
  )

  data.frame(
    subset            = subset_vec,
    depth             = depth,
    terminal_node     = terminal_node,
    modifier_1        = modifier_1,
    modifier_2        = modifier_2,
    pathInCompartment = pathInCompartment,
    rootPath          = rootPath,
    root              = root,
    path              = path,
    stringsAsFactors  = FALSE
  )

}

nodes <- make_nodes(subset_vec, root_all, root_ag)


# helper: pick first non-NA / non-blank
first_non_na <- function(x) {
  y <- x[!is.na(x) & x != ""]
  if (length(y)) y[1] else NA
}

## ---- Design: one row per ALId, with paired sample names/paths ----
# collapse to a single record per (ALId, compartment)
pair_map <- df %>%
  mutate(ALId = as.character(ALId)) %>%
  group_by(ALId, compartment) %>%
  summarize(
    sample_key      = first_non_na(sample_key),
    fcs_file        = first_non_na(fcs_file),
    transformed_fcs = first_non_na(transformed_fcs),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols    = ALId,
    names_from = compartment,
    values_from = c(sample_key, fcs_file, transformed_fcs),
    names_sep  = "_"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    sample_global            = sample_key_global,
    sample_ag                = sample_key_antigen_specific,
    fcs_file_global          = fcs_file_global,
    fcs_file_ag              = fcs_file_antigen_specific,
    transformed_fcs_global   = transformed_fcs_global,
    transformed_fcs_ag       = transformed_fcs_antigen_specific
  )

## ---- Metadata per ALId (only over columns that exist) ----
meta_cols <- intersect(
  c("patientType","khorLabId","ageAtDraw","sex","group","batch","drawDate","race","hispanic"),
  names(df)
)

meta_by_AL <- df %>%
  mutate(ALId = as.character(ALId)) %>%
  group_by(ALId) %>%
  summarize(
    across(all_of(meta_cols), first_non_na, .names = "{.col}"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

design_out <- meta_by_AL %>%
  full_join(pair_map, by = "ALId") %>%
  arrange(ALId)


# Reorder matrices’ columns to ALId order in design_out
al_order <- design_out$ALId
have     <- intersect(colnames(pctParent), al_order)
pctParent    <- pctParent    %>% select(subset_label, all_of(have)) %>% rename(subset = subset_label)
parentCounts <- parentCounts %>% select(subset_label, all_of(have)) %>% rename(subset = subset_label)
popCounts    <- popCounts    %>% select(subset_label, all_of(have)) %>% rename(subset = subset_label)

# ---- Package & save ----
New_matrices_PBplus <- list(
  parentCounts = parentCounts,
  popCounts    = popCounts,
  pctParent    = pctParent,
  design       = design_out,   # must contain ALId
  nodes        = nodes
)

library(dplyr)

# Normalize ALId type on both tables
New_matrices_PBplus$design <- New_matrices_PBplus$design %>% mutate(ALId = as.character(ALId))
design_fix <- design %>% mutate(ALId = as.character(ALId))

# Pick up the two fields from your original 'design' if they exist
want <- intersect(c("testId", "longitudinalDrawDescription"), names(design_fix))

if (length(want)) {
  extra_by_AL <- design_fix %>%
    group_by(ALId) %>%
    summarize(across(all_of(want), ~ dplyr::first(na.omit(.x))), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Attach without dropping anything already present
  New_matrices_PBplus$design <- New_matrices_PBplus$design %>%
    left_join(extra_by_AL, by = "ALId")
}

# Save
dir.create("/Users/rgomez/Khor_covidvax_response_IMPACD/data_RG_2025_05/roots",
           showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

save(New_matrices_PBplus,
     file = "/Users/rgomez/Khor_covidvax_response_IMPACD/data_RG_2025_05/roots/Full_object_PBplus.Rdata")
```

```{r build full non-PB Bcells object with all 5 matrices}
## Build reference-style full object for non-PB Bcells: columns = ALId, subsets prefixed by compartment
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(stringr)})

# ---- Inputs (minimal) ----
file <- "/Users/rgomez/Khor_covidvax_response_IMPACD/data_RG_2025_05/counts_Bcells.Rdata"
nm <- load(file)  # returns object names in the file

# The file currently contains 'counts' (not 'counts_Bcells')
if (exists("counts_Bcells")) {
  # use it as-is
} else if (exists("counts")) {
  counts_Bcells <- counts
} else {
  stop("Neither 'counts_Bcells' nor 'counts' found in the loaded file: ", paste(nm, collapse=", "))
}

stopifnot(is.data.frame(counts_Bcells))


#load("/Users/rgomez/Khor_covidvax_response_IMPACD/data_RG_2025_05/counts_NEW_PBplus.Rdata") # -> counts_NEW_PBplus (long)
stopifnot(exists("design"))


suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(stringr)})

# --- Roots (your current layout) ---
root_all <- "/Live_Stringent/LYM/Barcode/CD19+ dump-/B cells/PB"
root_ag  <- "/Live_Stringent/LYM/Barcode/CD19+ dump-/B cells/RBD+/PB"

strip_prefix <- function(x, prefix){
  out <- x
  i1 <- startsWith(x, paste0(prefix, "/")); out[i1] <- substring(x[i1], nchar(prefix) + 2L)
  i2 <- startsWith(x, prefix) & !i1;        out[i2] <- substring(x[i2], nchar(prefix) + 1L)
  out
}

# --- Pick the wide matrices you actually have ---
W_counts       <- if (exists("counts")) counts else if (exists("pop_counts")) pop_counts else stop("No counts/pop_counts matrix found")
W_parentCounts <- parentCounts
W_pctParent    <- pctParent

stopifnot(is.data.frame(W_counts),  "subset" %in% names(W_counts))
stopifnot(is.data.frame(W_parentCounts), "subset" %in% names(W_parentCounts))
stopifnot(is.data.frame(W_pctParent),    "subset" %in% names(W_pctParent))

# --- Helper: build a compartment-specific ALId-wide matrix from a wide table ---
make_comp_mat <- function(W, design, comp_label, root_prefix) {
  # columns to keep (this enforces global=PRE and antigen=ENRICHED because design is filtered)
  keep_samples <- design %>% dplyr::filter(compartment == comp_label) %>% pull(sampleName)
  have <- intersect(keep_samples, names(W))
  if (length(have) == 0) stop("No columns in wide matrix match design sampleName for compartment: ", comp_label)
  
  M <- W %>% select(subset, all_of(have))
  
  # rename columns to ALId
  map <- design %>% dplyr::filter(compartment == comp_label) %>% select(sampleName, ALId)
  new_names <- map$ALId[match(have, map$sampleName)]
  colnames(M)[match(have, names(M))] <- new_names
  
  # subset label: prefix with compartment; strip root to relative
  rel <- strip_prefix(M$subset, root_prefix)
  subset_label <- ifelse(rel == "" | is.na(rel), comp_label, paste0(comp_label, "/", rel))
  
  # long -> collapse unique (subset, ALId) -> back to wide with ALId columns
  M_long <- M %>%
    mutate(subset_label = subset_label) %>%
    select(-subset) %>%
    pivot_longer(-subset_label, names_to = "ALId", values_to = "val")
  
  M_wide <- M_long %>%
    group_by(subset_label, ALId) %>%
    summarize(val = dplyr::first(val), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = ALId, values_from = val) %>%
    arrange(subset_label)
  
  # uniform 'subset' column name downstream
  M_wide <- M_wide %>% rename(subset = subset_label)
  M_wide
}

# --- Build the three matrices, compartment by compartment, then bind rows ---
C_global   <- make_comp_mat(W_counts,       design, "all_Bcells",       root_all)   %>%
  mutate(subset = sub("^all_Bcells", "global", subset))
C_antigen  <- make_comp_mat(W_counts,       design, "antigen_specific", root_ag)

PC_global  <- make_comp_mat(W_parentCounts, design, "all_Bcells",       root_all)   %>%
  mutate(subset = sub("^all_Bcells", "global", subset))
PC_antigen <- make_comp_mat(W_parentCounts, design, "antigen_specific", root_ag)

PP_global  <- make_comp_mat(W_pctParent,    design, "all_Bcells",       root_all)   %>%
  mutate(subset = sub("^all_Bcells", "global", subset))
PP_antigen <- make_comp_mat(W_pctParent,    design, "antigen_specific", root_ag)

popCounts    <- bind_rows(C_global,  C_antigen)
parentCounts <- bind_rows(PC_global, PC_antigen)
pctParent    <- bind_rows(PP_global, PP_antigen)

# --- Nodes table (from the bound subset labels) ---
subset_vec <- popCounts$subset
make_nodes <- function(subset_vec, root_all, root_ag) {
  comp <- ifelse(grepl("^antigen_specific($|/)", subset_vec), "antigen_specific", "global")
  rel  <- ifelse(comp == "global",
                 sub("^global/?", "", subset_vec),
                 sub("^antigen_specific/?", "", subset_vec))
  parts <- strsplit(rel, "/", fixed = TRUE)
  ncomp <- vapply(parts, length, integer(1))
  terminal_node <- vapply(seq_along(parts), function(i) if (ncomp[i]==0) comp[i] else tail(parts[[i]],1), character(1))
  modifier_1    <- vapply(seq_along(parts), function(i) if (ncomp[i]>=2) parts[[i]][1] else NA_character_, character(1))
  modifier_2    <- vapply(seq_along(parts), function(i) if (ncomp[i]>=3) parts[[i]][2] else NA_character_, character(1))
  depth         <- ncomp
  rootPath      <- ifelse(comp == "global", root_all, root_ag)
  pathInComp    <- ifelse(ncomp==0, NA_character_, rel)
  path          <- ifelse(ncomp==0, rootPath, paste(rootPath, rel, sep="/"))
  data.frame(subset=subset_vec, depth, terminal_node, modifier_1, modifier_2,
             pathInCompartment=pathInComp, rootPath=rootPath, root=comp, path=path,
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
nodes <- make_nodes(subset_vec, root_all, root_ag)

# --- Design_out: one row per ALId with metadata (from your filtered 'design') ---
first_non_na <- function(x){ y <- x[!is.na(x) & x!=""]; if (length(y)) y[1] else NA }

meta_cols <- intersect(
  c("patientType","khorLabId","ageAtDraw","sex","group","batch",
    "drawDate","race","hispanic","timePoint","control"),
  names(design)
)

design_out <- design %>%
  mutate(ALId = as.character(ALId)) %>%
  group_by(ALId) %>%
  summarize(across(all_of(meta_cols), first_non_na, .names = "{.col}"),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(ALId)

# If you want to add testId & longitudinalDrawDescription from 'design'
want <- intersect(c("testId", "longitudinalDrawDescription"), names(design))
if (length(want)) {
  extra_by_AL <- design %>% group_by(ALId) %>%
    summarize(across(all_of(want), ~ first_non_na(.x)), .groups="drop")
  design_out <- design_out %>% left_join(extra_by_AL, by="ALId")
}

# --- Reorder matrix columns to ALId order ---
al_order <- design_out$ALId
keepc <- function(M){
  have <- intersect(colnames(M), c("subset", al_order))
  M %>% select(all_of(have)) %>% relocate(subset)
}
popCounts    <- keepc(popCounts)
parentCounts <- keepc(parentCounts)
pctParent    <- keepc(pctParent)

# --- Drop the PB+ artifact rows if present ---
drop_rows <- c("global/+", "antigen_specific/+")
popCounts    <- popCounts   [!popCounts$subset    %in% drop_rows, , drop = FALSE]
parentCounts <- parentCounts[!parentCounts$subset %in% drop_rows, , drop = FALSE]
pctParent    <- pctParent   [!pctParent$subset    %in% drop_rows, , drop = FALSE]

# --- Package & save ---
New_matrices_Bcells <- list(
  parentCounts = parentCounts,
  popCounts    = popCounts,
  pctParent    = pctParent,
  design       = design_out,
  nodes        = nodes
)

dir.create("/Users/rgomez/Khor_covidvax_response_IMPACD/data_RG_2025_05/roots",
           showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

save(New_matrices_Bcells,
     file = "/Users/rgomez/Khor_covidvax_response_IMPACD/data_RG_2025_05/roots/Full_object_Bcells.Rdata")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(dplyr); library(tidyr)})

# Build pre/enriched file columns from your filtered design
fcs_pairs <- design %>%
  select(ALId, compartment, sampleName, sampleNameOriginal, fcsFiles, transformedFcs) %>%
  mutate(compartment = recode(compartment,
                              "all_Bcells"       = "pre",
                              "antigen_specific" = "enriched")) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols    = ALId,
    names_from = compartment,
    values_from = c(sampleName, sampleNameOriginal, fcsFiles, transformedFcs),
    names_sep  = "_"
  ) %>%
  rename(
    sample_pre                 = sampleName_pre,
    sample_enriched            = sampleName_enriched,
    sample_raw_pre             = sampleNameOriginal_pre,
    sample_raw_enriched        = sampleNameOriginal_enriched,
    fcs_file_pre               = fcsFiles_pre,
    fcs_file_enriched          = fcsFiles_enriched,
    transformed_fcs_pre        = transformedFcs_pre,
    transformed_fcs_enriched   = transformedFcs_enriched
  )

# Attach and save
New_matrices_Bcells$design <- New_matrices_Bcells$design %>%
  left_join(fcs_pairs, by = "ALId")

save(New_matrices_Bcells,
     file = "/Users/rgomez/Khor_covidvax_response_IMPACD/data_RG_2025_05/roots/Full_object_Bcells.Rdata")
```

```{r build full Q1: switched memory object with all 5 matrices}
## Build reference-style full object for SM (Q1): columns = ALId, subsets prefixed by compartment
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(stringr)})

# Exact SM roots (auto paths)

root_ag  <- "/Live_Stringent/LYM/Barcode/CD19+ dump-/B cells/RBD+/PB/Q1: IgD_BUV615- , CD27_APCR700+"

strip_prefix <- function(x, prefix){
  out <- x
  i1 <- startsWith(x, paste0(prefix, "/")); out[i1] <- substring(x[i1], nchar(prefix) + 2L)
  i2 <- startsWith(x, prefix) & !i1;        out[i2] <- substring(x[i2], nchar(prefix) + 1L)
  out
}

# ---- Long table with ALId + compartment + relative subset ----
# Map each FCS to ALId and metadata (robust to column name variations)
design_map <- design %>%
  mutate(
    sample_file = dplyr::coalesce(
      get0("sampleNameOriginal", ifnotfound = NULL),
      get0("sampleName",         ifnotfound = NULL),
      basename(get0("fcsFiles",  ifnotfound = ""))  # fallback
    ),
    sample_key  = sub("\\.fcs$","", basename(sample_file))
  ) %>%
  select(
    ALId, sample_key,

    group       = any_of("group"),
    batch       = any_of("batch"),
    fcs_file        = any_of("fcsFiles"),
    transformed_fcs = any_of("transformedFcs"),
    drawDate        = any_of("drawDate"),
    race            = any_of("race"),
    hispanic        = any_of("hispanic")
  ) %>%
  distinct()

# Attach ALId/metadata to counts_SM
df <- counts%>%
  mutate(
    sample_key  = sub("\\.fcs$","", basename(as.character(name))),
    compartment = if_else(grepl("/RBD\\+/", Population), "antigen_specific", "global")
  ) %>%
  left_join(design_map, by = "sample_key") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("IC", sample_key, fixed = TRUE))

# Sanity: drop rows missing ALId (cannot pivot by AL)
missing_al <- df %>% dplyr::filter(is.na(ALId)) %>% distinct(sample_key)
if (nrow(missing_al)) message("Warning: dropping ", nrow(missing_al), " rows with missing ALId.")

df <- df %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(ALId))

# Relative subset under the two SM roots
rel <- character(nrow(df))
i_all <- startsWith(df$Population, root_all)
i_ag  <- startsWith(df$Population, root_ag)
rel[i_all] <- strip_prefix(df$Population[i_all], root_all)
rel[i_ag ] <- strip_prefix(df$Population[i_ag ], root_ag )
df$rel_subset <- rel

# Final subset label: compartment + "/" + relative (root becomes just "global"/"antigen_specific")
df$subset_label <- if_else(df$rel_subset == "" | is.na(df$rel_subset),
                           df$compartment,
                           paste0(df$compartment, "/", df$rel_subset))

# ---- Matrices: rows=subset_label, cols=ALId ----
collapse_wide <- function(dat, value_col){
  dat %>%
    group_by(subset_label, ALId) %>%
    summarize(val = dplyr::first(.data[[value_col]]), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(ALId = as.character(ALId)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = ALId, values_from = val) %>%
    arrange(subset_label)
}

pctParent    <- collapse_wide(df, "PercentParent")
parentCounts <- collapse_wide(df, "ParentCount")
popCounts    <- collapse_wide(df, "Count")

## ---- Nodes: terminal_node + clean modifiers + root columns ----
# pick the subset column you actually have
subset_vec <- if ("subset_label" %in% names(pctParent)) pctParent$subset_label else pctParent$subset

make_nodes <- function(subset_vec, root_all, root_ag) {
  comp <- ifelse(grepl("^antigen_specific($|/)", subset_vec), "antigen_specific", "global")
  rel  <- ifelse(comp == "global",
                 sub("^global/?", "", subset_vec),
                 sub("^antigen_specific/?", "", subset_vec))
  
  parts <- strsplit(rel, "/", fixed = TRUE)
  ncomp <- vapply(parts, length, integer(1))
  
  terminal_node <- vapply(seq_along(parts), function(i) {
    if (ncomp[i] == 0) comp[i] else tail(parts[[i]], 1)
  }, character(1))
  
  modifier_1 <- vapply(seq_along(parts), function(i) {
    if (ncomp[i] >= 2) parts[[i]][1] else NA_character_
  }, character(1))
  
  modifier_2 <- vapply(seq_along(parts), function(i) {
    if (ncomp[i] >= 3) parts[[i]][2] else NA_character_
  }, character(1))
  
  depth <- ncomp  # root (no tokens) = 0; single token = 1; etc.
  
  rootPath <- ifelse(comp == "global", root_all, root_ag)
  pathInCompartment <- ifelse(ncomp == 0, NA_character_, rel)
  path <- ifelse(ncomp == 0, rootPath, paste(rootPath, rel, sep = "/"))
  
  data.frame(
    subset            = subset_vec,
    depth             = depth,
    terminal_node     = terminal_node,
    modifier_1        = modifier_1,
    modifier_2        = modifier_2,
    pathInCompartment = pathInCompartment,
    rootPath          = rootPath,
    root = ifelse(
  comp == "global",
  paste0("global/", sub("^/Live_Stringent/LYM/Barcode/CD19\\+ dump-/B cells/?", "", root_all)),
  paste0("antigen_specific/", sub("^/Live_Stringent/LYM/Barcode/CD19\\+ dump-/B cells/?", "", root_ag))
)
,
    path              = path,
    stringsAsFactors  = FALSE
  )
}

nodes <- make_nodes(subset_vec, root_all, root_ag)


# helper: pick first non-NA / non-blank
first_non_na <- function(x) {
  y <- x[!is.na(x) & x != ""]
  if (length(y)) y[1] else NA
}

## ---- Design: one row per ALId, with paired sample names/paths ----
# collapse to a single record per (ALId, compartment)
pair_map <- df %>%
  mutate(ALId = as.character(ALId)) %>%
  group_by(ALId, compartment) %>%
  summarize(
    sample_key      = first_non_na(sample_key),
    fcs_file        = first_non_na(fcs_file),
    transformed_fcs = first_non_na(transformed_fcs),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols    = ALId,
    names_from = compartment,
    values_from = c(sample_key, fcs_file, transformed_fcs),
    names_sep  = "_"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    sample_global            = sample_key_global,
    sample_ag                = sample_key_antigen_specific,
    fcs_file_global          = fcs_file_global,
    fcs_file_ag              = fcs_file_antigen_specific,
    transformed_fcs_global   = transformed_fcs_global,
    transformed_fcs_ag       = transformed_fcs_antigen_specific
  )

## ---- Metadata per ALId (only over columns that exist) ----
meta_cols <- intersect(
  c("patientType","khorLabId","ageAtDraw","sex","group","batch","drawDate","race","hispanic"),
  names(df)
)

meta_by_AL <- df %>%
  mutate(ALId = as.character(ALId)) %>%
  group_by(ALId) %>%
  summarize(
    across(all_of(meta_cols), first_non_na, .names = "{.col}"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

design_out <- meta_by_AL %>%
  full_join(pair_map, by = "ALId") %>%
  arrange(ALId)


# Reorder matrices’ columns to ALId order in design_out
al_order <- design_out$ALId
have     <- intersect(colnames(pctParent), al_order)
pctParent    <- pctParent    %>% select(subset_label, all_of(have)) %>% rename(subset = subset_label)
parentCounts <- parentCounts %>% select(subset_label, all_of(have)) %>% rename(subset = subset_label)
popCounts    <- popCounts    %>% select(subset_label, all_of(have)) %>% rename(subset = subset_label)

# ---- Package & save ----
New_matrices_SM <- list(

library(dplyr)

# Normalize ALId type on both tables

design_fix <- design %>% mutate(ALId = as.character(ALId))

# Pick up the two fields from your original 'design' if they exist

if (length(want)) {

    left_join(extra_by_AL, by = "ALId")
}

           showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

save(New_matrices_SM,
```

```{r build full Q2: nonswitched memory object with all 5 matrices}
# --- Build full NSM object (Q2: NSM) with all 5 matrices ----------------------

root_ag  <- "/Live_Stringent/LYM/Barcode/CD19+ dump-/B cells/RBD+/PB/Q2: IgD_BUV615+ , CD27_APCR700+"

strip_prefix <- function(x, prefix){
  out <- x
  i1 <- startsWith(x, paste0(prefix, "/")); out[i1] <- substring(x[i1], nchar(prefix) + 2L)
  i2 <- startsWith(x, prefix) & !i1;        out[i2] <- substring(x[i2], nchar(prefix) + 1L)
  out
}

# ---- Map FCS to ALId and metadata (robust to column variations) ----
design_map <- design %>%

    race            = any_of("race"),
    hispanic        = any_of("hispanic")
  ) %>%
  distinct()

  ) %>%

df <- df %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(ALId))

# ---- Relative subset under the two NSM roots ----

i_ag  <- startsWith(df$Population, root_ag)

rel[i_ag ] <- strip_prefix(df$Population[i_ag ], root_ag )

collapse_wide <- function(dat, value_col){
  dat %>%
    group_by(subset_label, ALId) %>%

# ---- Nodes (PBplus-style) with NSM-specific root strings ---------------------
# You asked for explicit roots in "root" field:
#   global root           = "global/Bcells/PB/Q2: IgD_BUV615+ , CD27_APCR700+"
#   antigen_specific root = "antigen_specific/Bcells/RBD+/PB/Q2: IgD_BUV615+ , CD27_APCR700+"
subset_vec <- if ("subset_label" %in% names(pctParent)) pctParent$subset_label else pctParent$subset

make_nodes_nsm <- function(subset_vec, root_all, root_ag) {
  comp <- ifelse(grepl("^antigen_specific($|/)", subset_vec), "antigen_specific", "global")
  rel  <- ifelse(comp == "global",
                 sub("^global/?", "", subset_vec),
                 sub("^antigen_specific/?", "", subset_vec))

  parts <- strsplit(rel, "/", fixed = TRUE)
  ncomp <- vapply(parts, length, integer(1))

  terminal_node <- vapply(seq_along(parts), function(i) {
    if (ncomp[i] == 0) comp[i] else tail(parts[[i]], 1)
  }, character(1))

  modifier_1 <- vapply(seq_along(parts), function(i) {
    if (ncomp[i] >= 2) parts[[i]][1] else NA_character_
  }, character(1))

  modifier_2 <- vapply(seq_along(parts), function(i) {
    if (ncomp[i] >= 3) parts[[i]][2] else NA_character_
  }, character(1))

  depth <- ncomp  # root=0; one token=1; etc.

  rootPath <- ifelse(comp == "global", root_all, root_ag)
  pathInCompartment <- ifelse(ncomp == 0, NA_character_, rel)
  path <- ifelse(ncomp == 0, rootPath, paste(rootPath, rel, sep = "/"))

  root_global_str <- "global/Bcells/PB/Q2: IgD_BUV615+ , CD27_APCR700+"
  root_ag_str     <- "antigen_specific/Bcells/RBD+/PB/Q2: IgD_BUV615+ , CD27_APCR700+"
  root_field <- ifelse(comp == "global", root_global_str, root_ag_str)

  data.frame(
    subset            = subset_vec,
    depth             = depth,
    terminal_node     = terminal_node,
    modifier_1        = modifier_1,
    modifier_2        = modifier_2,
    pathInCompartment = pathInCompartment,
    rootPath          = rootPath,
    root              = root_field,
    path              = path,
    stringsAsFactors  = FALSE
  )
}
```

## build full Q4: Double negative object with all 5 matrices
```{r build full Q4: Double negative object with all 5 matrices}
# --- Build full DN object (Q4: DN) with all 5 matrices -----------------------
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(stringr)})

# ---- Inputs ----
file <- "/Users/rgomez/Khor_covidvax_response_IMPACD/data_RG_2025_05/roots/counts_NEW_DN.Rdata"
nm <- load(file)  # robust to whatever the object name is

# Pick/alias the long table to a consistent name
pick <- NULL
for (n in nm) {
  obj <- get(n, inherits = TRUE)
  if (is.data.frame(obj) && all(c("Population","name") %in% names(obj))) { pick <- n; break }
}
if (is.null(pick) && length(nm) == 1) pick <- nm[1]
stopifnot(!is.null(pick))
counts_NEW_DN <- get(pick, inherits = TRUE)
stopifnot(is.data.frame(counts_NEW_DN))

# Require 'design' to be present (as with NSM/Tn)
stopifnot(exists("design"))

# ---- ROOTS (exact strings) ----
root_all <- "/Live_Stringent/LYM/Barcode/CD19+ dump-/B cells/PB/Q4: IgD_BUV615- , CD27_APCR700-"
root_ag  <- "/Live_Stringent/LYM/Barcode/CD19+ dump-/B cells/RBD+/PB/Q4: IgD_BUV615- , CD27_APCR700-"

strip_prefix <- function(x, prefix){
  out <- x
  i1 <- startsWith(x, paste0(prefix, "/")); out[i1] <- substring(x[i1], nchar(prefix) + 2L)
  i2 <- startsWith(x, prefix) & !i1;        out[i2] <- substring(x[i2], nchar(prefix) + 1L)
  out
}

# ---- Map FCS to ALId and metadata (robust to design column variants) ----
design_map <- design %>%
  mutate(
    sample_file = dplyr::coalesce(
      get0("sampleNameOriginal", ifnotfound = NULL),
      get0("sampleName",         ifnotfound = NULL),
      basename(get0("fcsFiles",  ifnotfound = ""))  # fallback
    ),
    sample_key  = sub("\\.fcs$","", basename(sample_file))
  ) %>%
  select(
    ALId, sample_key,
    patientType = any_of("patientType"),
    khorLabId   = any_of("khorLabId"),
    ageAtDraw   = any_of("ageAtDraw"),
    sex         = any_of("sex"),
    group       = any_of("group"),
    batch       = any_of("batch"),
    fcs_file        = any_of("fcsFiles"),
    transformed_fcs = any_of("transformedFcs"),
    drawDate        = any_of("drawDate"),
    race            = any_of("race"),
    hispanic        = any_of("hispanic")
  ) %>%
  distinct()

# ---- Attach ALId/metadata; call compartments from Population; drop ICs ----
df <- counts_NEW_DN %>%
  mutate(
    sample_key  = sub("\\.fcs$","", basename(as.character(name))),
    compartment = if_else(grepl("/RBD\\+/", Population), "antigen_specific", "global")
  ) %>%
  left_join(design_map, by = "sample_key") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("IC", sample_key, fixed = TRUE))

# Drop rows lacking ALId (cannot pivot)
missing_al <- df %>% dplyr::filter(is.na(ALId)) %>% distinct(sample_key)
if (nrow(missing_al)) message("Warning: dropping ", nrow(missing_al), " rows with missing ALId.")
df <- df %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(ALId))

# ---- Relative subset under the two DN roots ----
rel <- character(nrow(df))
i_all <- startsWith(df$Population, root_all)
i_ag  <- startsWith(df$Population, root_ag)
rel[i_all] <- strip_prefix(df$Population[i_all], root_all)
rel[i_ag ] <- strip_prefix(df$Population[i_ag ], root_ag )
df$rel_subset <- rel

# Final subset label: compartment or compartment/<relative>
df$subset_label <- if_else(df$rel_subset == "" | is.na(df$rel_subset),
                           df$compartment,
                           paste0(df$compartment, "/", df$rel_subset))

# ---- Matrices: rows=subset_label, cols=ALId ----
collapse_wide <- function(dat, value_col){
  dat %>%
    group_by(subset_label, ALId) %>%
    summarize(val = dplyr::first(.data[[value_col]]), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(ALId = as.character(ALId)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = ALId, values_from = val) %>%
    arrange(subset_label)
}

pctParent    <- collapse_wide(df, "PercentParent")
parentCounts <- collapse_wide(df, "ParentCount")
popCounts    <- collapse_wide(df, "Count")

# ---- Nodes (NSM/Tn-style) with explicit DN root strings ---------------------
subset_vec <- if ("subset_label" %in% names(pctParent)) pctParent$subset_label else pctParent$subset

make_nodes_dn <- function(subset_vec, root_all, root_ag) {
  comp <- ifelse(grepl("^antigen_specific($|/)", subset_vec), "antigen_specific", "global")
  rel  <- ifelse(comp == "global",
                 sub("^global/?", "", subset_vec),
                 sub("^antigen_specific/?", "", subset_vec))

  parts <- strsplit(rel, "/", fixed = TRUE)
  ncomp <- vapply(parts, length, integer(1))

  terminal_node <- vapply(seq_along(parts), function(i) {
    if (ncomp[i] == 0) comp[i] else tail(parts[[i]], 1)
  }, character(1))

  modifier_1 <- vapply(seq_along(parts), function(i) {
    if (ncomp[i] >= 2) parts[[i]][1] else NA_character_
  }, character(1))

  modifier_2 <- vapply(seq_along(parts), function(i) {
    if (ncomp[i] >= 3) parts[[i]][2] else NA_character_
  }, character(1))

  depth <- ncomp

  rootPath <- ifelse(comp == "global", root_all, root_ag)
  pathInCompartment <- ifelse(ncomp == 0, NA_character_, rel)
  path <- ifelse(ncomp == 0, rootPath, paste(rootPath, rel, sep = "/"))

  root_global_str <- "global/Bcells/PB/Q4: IgD_BUV615- , CD27_APCR700-"
  root_ag_str     <- "antigen_specific/Bcells/RBD+/PB/Q4: IgD_BUV615- , CD27_APCR700-"
  root_field <- ifelse(comp == "global", root_global_str, root_ag_str)

  data.frame(
    subset            = subset_vec,
    depth             = depth,
    terminal_node     = terminal_node,
    modifier_1        = modifier_1,
    modifier_2        = modifier_2,
    pathInCompartment = pathInCompartment,
    rootPath          = rootPath,
    root              = root_field,
    path              = path,
    stringsAsFactors  = FALSE
  )
}

nodes <- make_nodes_dn(subset_vec, root_all, root_ag)

# ---- Helper: first non-NA / non-blank ----
first_non_na <- function(x) {
  y <- x[!is.na(x) & x != ""]
  if (length(y)) y[1] else NA
}

# ---- Design: 1 row per ALId, plus paired sample names/paths ----
pair_map <- df %>%
  mutate(ALId = as.character(ALId)) %>%
  group_by(ALId, compartment) %>%
  summarize(
    sample_key      = first_non_na(sample_key),
    fcs_file        = first_non_na(fcs_file),
    transformed_fcs = first_non_na(transformed_fcs),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols    = ALId,
    names_from = compartment,
    values_from = c(sample_key, fcs_file, transformed_fcs),
    names_sep  = "_"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    sample_global            = sample_key_global,
    sample_ag                = sample_key_antigen_specific,
    fcs_file_global          = fcs_file_global,
    fcs_file_ag              = fcs_file_antigen_specific,
    transformed_fcs_global   = transformed_fcs_global,
    transformed_fcs_ag       = transformed_fcs_antigen_specific
  )

# ---- Metadata per ALId (only over columns that exist) ----
meta_cols <- intersect(
  c("patientType","khorLabId","ageAtDraw","sex","group","batch","drawDate","race","hispanic"),
  names(df)
)

meta_by_AL <- df %>%
  mutate(ALId = as.character(ALId)) %>%
  group_by(ALId) %>%
  summarize(
    across(all_of(meta_cols), first_non_na, .names = "{.col}"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

design_out <- meta_by_AL %>%
  full_join(pair_map, by = "ALId") %>%
  arrange(ALId)

# ---- Reorder matrices’ columns to ALId order ----
al_order <- design_out$ALId
have     <- intersect(colnames(pctParent), al_order)
pctParent    <- pctParent    %>% select(subset_label, all_of(have)) %>% rename(subset = subset_label)
parentCounts <- parentCounts %>% select(subset_label, all_of(have)) %>% rename(subset = subset_label)
popCounts    <- popCounts    %>% select(subset_label, all_of(have)) %>% rename(subset = subset_label)

# ---- Package ----
New_matrices_DN <- list(
  parentCounts = parentCounts,
  popCounts    = popCounts,
  pctParent    = pctParent,
  design       = design_out,
  nodes        = nodes
)

# ---- Carry over extras from original 'design' if present ----
New_matrices_DN$design <- New_matrices_DN$design %>% mutate(ALId = as.character(ALId))
design_fix <- design %>% mutate(ALId = as.character(ALId))

want <- intersect(c("testId", "longitudinalDrawDescription"), names(design_fix))
if (length(want)) {
  extra_by_AL <- design_fix %>%
    group_by(ALId) %>%
    summarize(across(all_of(want), ~ dplyr::first(na.omit(.))), .groups = "drop")
  New_matrices_DN$design <- New_matrices_DN$design %>%
    left_join(extra_by_AL, by = "ALId")
}

# ---- Save ----
dir.create("/Users/rgomez/Khor_covidvax_response_IMPACD/data_RG_2025_05/roots",
           showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

save(New_matrices_DN,
     file = "/Users/rgomez/Khor_covidvax_response_IMPACD/data_RG_2025_05/roots/Full_object_DN.Rdata")
```

## calculate what pct of B cells gate are Tn (Q3) for both compartments
```{r calculate what pct of B cells gate are Tn (Q3) for both compartments}
############ How to calculate what pct of B cells gate are Tn (Q3) for both compartments ########################################

# Percent of *B cells* that are True naive (Q3), for both compartments
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# 1) Load the leaf (Q3) object and the full long table (for denominators)
load("/Users/rgomez/Khor_covidvax_response_IMPACD/data_RG_2025_05/roots/counts_Tn.Rdata")         # -> counts_Tn (only Q3 leaves)
load("/Users/rgomez/Khor_covidvax_response_IMPACD/data_RG_2025_05/counts_Bcells.Rdata")           # -> counts (all nodes long)

# 2) Pull the B-cells counts per sample (same file names)
bcell_path <- "/Live_Stringent/LYM/Barcode/CD19+ dump-/B cells"
denom <- counts %>%
  dplyr::filter(Population == bcell_path) %>%
  dplyr::select(name, BcellsCount = Count)

# 3) Join and compute % of B cells
tn_b <- counts_Tn %>%
  dplyr::left_join(denom, by = "name") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(PercentOfB = 100 * Count / BcellsCount)

# (optional) quick sanity
missing_den <- sum(is.na(tn_b$BcellsCount))
if (missing_den > 0) message("Missing B-cells denominator for ", missing_den, " rows (check sample names).")

# 4) Plot: x = compartment, y = % of B cells that are True naive (Q3)
ggplot(tn_b, aes(x = compartment, y = PercentOfB)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.35) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0, size = 1.4, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  labs(title = "True naive (Q3) — % of B cells", x = "Compartment", y = "% of B cells")

# True naive (Q3): export table for sanity check
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

# 1) Load leaf (Q3) object and the full long table (for denominators)
load("/Users/rgomez/Khor_covidvax_response_IMPACD/data_RG_2025_05/roots/counts_Tn.Rdata")         # -> counts_Tn (only Q3 leaves)
load("/Users/rgomez/Khor_covidvax_response_IMPACD/data_RG_2025_05/counts_Bcells.Rdata")           # -> counts (all nodes long)

# 2) Pull B-cells (denominator) per sample
bcell_path <- "/Live_Stringent/LYM/Barcode/CD19+ dump-/B cells"
denom_b <- counts %>%
  dplyr::filter(Population == bcell_path) %>%
  select(name, BcellsCount = Count)

# 3) Build sanity table: keep the two exact Q3 leaves, join denom, compute % of B cells
tn_tbl <- counts_Tn %>%
  select(name, Population, Count, ParentCount, PercentParent, compartment) %>%
  left_join(denom_b, by = "name") %>%
  mutate(
    sampleName   = sub("\\.fcs$", "", name),
    PercentOfB   = 100 * Count / BcellsCount
  ) %>%
  select(sampleName, compartment, Population,
         Count, ParentCount, PercentParent,
         BcellsCount, PercentOfB) %>%
  arrange(compartment, sampleName)

# 4) Write CSV
out_dir <- "/Users/rgomez/Khor_covidvax_response_IMPACD/tables_RG_2025_05/Flow/Bcells"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
write_csv(tn_tbl, file.path(out_dir, "true_naive_Q3_percent_of_Bcells.csv"))
```
